replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Any music plans for your free time?
replies.translation: 空いた時間に音楽の予定はある？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: I've got a new recipe to try.
replies.translation: 新しいレシピを試したいんだ。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: 今夜ジャズを聴きにおいで！

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.translation: おすすめの曲、聞きたい？

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: The library has a mystery shelf.
replies.translation: 図書館にはミステリーの棚があるよ。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: 退屈って地球の趣味なの？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 休むことも前進の一部だよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: もう夕飯は食べた？

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.translation: ちょっと昼寝するとよさそう。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I hope you get a break soon.
replies.translation: もうすぐ休めるといいね。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: My calendar needs its own calendar.
replies.translation: 私の予定表には予定表が必要だよ。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 一つずつやろう。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 何か素敵なことがあった？

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: That calls for a happy song!
replies.translation: そんなときは楽しい曲だね！

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: 幸せってここでは伝染するみたいだね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: 私たちの分の楽しみも残して！

replies.author: Chloe Spark
replies.translation: 何をして楽しんでるの？

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.translation: 音楽もあるといいな！

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 誰かがそばにいたら少し楽かな？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: I can make you some soup.
replies.translation: スープを作ってあげられるよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 話を聞こうか？

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Want to tell me what happened?
replies.translation: 何があったか話す？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: You don't have to answer right now.
replies.translation: 今すぐ返事をしなくてもいいよ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: That sounds like a coffee break.
replies.translation: それはコーヒー休憩の出番だね。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: ただ静かに座っててもいいよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: I'll save you a warm meal.
replies.translation: 温かいご飯を取っておくね。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: つらい日が永遠に続くわけじゃないよ。

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.translation: 私までワクワクしてきた！

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 何か大きなことがあるの？

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: 紙吹雪を用意したほうがいい？

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: I get nervous before concerts too.
replies.translation: 私もコンサート前は緊張するよ。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: ゆっくりでいいんだよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 一緒に練習する？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: What's the part you can control?
replies.translation: 自分で変えられる部分はどこかな？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: You don't need to handle it alone.
replies.translation: 一人で抱えなくていいよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Do you want to talk it through?
replies.translation: 一緒に話して整理する？

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: My first cup is already brewing.
replies.translation: 一杯目のコーヒーを淹れてるところ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 焼きたてパンができたよ！

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: おはよう！私はもう少し寝たいな。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: お昼ごはんはおいしかった？

replies.author: Ollie
replies.translation: 今日はどんな感じ？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: こんばんは！今夜は何か予定ある？

replies.author: Ollie
replies.text: The city lights are coming on.
replies.translation: 街の明かりがつき始めたね。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: おかえり！お腹すいた？

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: くつろぐ時間だね！

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.translation: 枕が呼んでるよ。

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: I'll put my violin away too.
replies.translation: 私もバイオリンを片づけよう。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 明日が穏やかな日になりますように。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.translation: 私の得意分野！枕を探そう。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Even I might skip this coffee.
replies.translation: 私でも今日はコーヒーを見送るかも。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.translation: あと一ページで消灯ね。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 今日のランチを試作中だよ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I have biscuits by the coffee.
replies.translation: コーヒーの横にビスケットがあるよ。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: How many meals do humans need?
replies.translation: 人間って何食必要なの？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Then my cooking did its job!
replies.translation: じゃあ私の料理は役目を果たしたね！

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.translation: 次は最高の昼寝だね。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: これは充電100％の状態？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: What did you eat? I need details!
replies.translation: 何を食べたの？詳しく教えて！

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.translation: 秘密のソースがあった？

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Save me a bite next time.
replies.translation: 次は私の分も一口残してね。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Close that laptop like a champion.
replies.translation: 勝者のようにノートPCを閉じよう。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 仕事のあとの夕飯はおいしいよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Time to switch to music mode?
replies.translation: 音楽モードに切り替える時間？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: That last note always feels special.
replies.translation: 最後の一音って特別だよね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: お客さんは大きく拍手してくれた？

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: Now give your hands a rest.
replies.translation: さあ、手を休ませてあげて。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 静かな五分でも役立つよ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: お湯を沸かしておくね。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.translation: ソファ、空いてるよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Is it one of those long days?
replies.translation: 今日は長い一日だった？

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Home is where the blanket is.
replies.translation: 家は毛布のある場所だよ。

replies.author: Bellport Transit
replies.text: Check the last train before leaving.
replies.translation: 帰る前に終電を確認してね。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: The wind went through my scarf.
replies.translation: 風がマフラーを通り抜けたよ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: 今日はホットチョコレートだね。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.translation: 予備のセーターを持ってきたよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 今日は冷たい麺がよさそう。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.translation: 私は日陰にいるね。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: 私のコーヒーまで氷を欲しがってる。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Have you packed everything you need?
replies.translation: 必要なものは全部用意した？

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.translation: ワクワクが伝わってくる！

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 楽しみに待つ時間も素敵だね。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 一番よかったのは何？

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.translation: その気持ちを大切にしてね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Let's end it with a song!
replies.translation: 歌で締めくくろう！

items.ja: 今日はツイてなかった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 明日は新しいページだよ。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: A warm meal won't fix everything, but it helps.
replies.translation: 温かいご飯で全部は直らないけど、少し楽になるよ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 静かなジャズを聴く？

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.translation: 図書館にヒントがあるかも。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: A walk by the harbor sounds nice.
replies.translation: 港を散歩するのもよさそう。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: I vote for an excellent nap.
replies.translation: 私は最高の昼寝に一票。
